tools.name: 3D Editor
tools.description: Browser-based 3D editor. Scene hierarchy, transform gizmos, material editor, undo/redo, save to disk or browser. A simple 3DS Max in your browser.

tools.name: 3D Model Viewer
tools.description: Interactive 3D model viewer with orbit controls. Load GLB, OBJ, STL, FBX files. Wireframe, stats, screenshots.

tools.name: Scene Composer
tools.description: Drag-and-drop Three.js scene builder. Add primitives, lights, cameras. Export as GLB.

tools.name: Mesh Optimizer
tools.description: Polygon reduction and mesh simplification. Merge vertices, recompute normals. Before/after comparison.

tools.name: Primitive Builder
tools.description: Create geometric primitives: box, sphere, cylinder, torus, cone, plane. Customize dimensions and export.

tools.name: Boolean Operations
tools.description: Union, subtract, intersect 3D shapes. CSG operations in the browser. Export result as GLB/STL.

tools.name: Mesh Inspector
tools.description: Vertex count, face stats, bounding box, wireframe view. Analyze mesh topology and quality.

tools.name: Format Converter
tools.description: Convert between GLB, OBJ, STL, FBX, GLTF. Drag-and-drop. Preserves materials and textures.

tools.name: GLTF Optimizer
tools.description: Compress GLTF/GLB files with Draco and meshopt. Reduce file size up to 90%. Compare before/after.

tools.name: STL Repair
tools.description: Fix non-manifold meshes, fill holes, orient normals. Prepare models for 3D printing.

tools.name: USDZ Preview
tools.description: Preview USDZ models for Apple AR Quick Look. Convert GLB to USDZ. Test AR placement.

tools.name: Texture Editor
tools.description: Resize, crop, adjust textures with live 3D preview. Color correction, channel editing, export.

tools.name: Material Library
tools.description: Browse PBR materials: metals, woods, stones, fabrics. Live preview on 3D models. Download textures.

tools.name: Normal Map Generator
tools.description: Generate normal maps from height maps or photos. Adjust strength, blur, invert. Real-time preview.

tools.name: HDRI Viewer
tools.description: Preview HDR environment maps on 3D models. Adjust exposure, rotation. Free HDRI library.

tools.name: UV Checker
tools.description: UV mapping visualization with checker patterns. Detect stretching, overlaps, and seams.

tools.name: Animation Mixer
tools.description: Blend and preview skeletal animations. Adjust speed, loop modes. Import/export animation clips.

tools.name: Keyframe Editor
tools.description: Simple keyframe animation editor. Position, rotation, scale over time. Timeline with curves.

tools.name: Turntable Renderer
tools.description: Auto-rotate model and export as GIF or video. Adjust speed, lighting, background. Product showcase.

tools.name: Measurement Tool
tools.description: Measure distances, angles, and volume on 3D models. Point-to-point, edge length, surface area.

tools.name: Screenshot Studio
tools.description: Professional product shots with lighting presets. Transparent/solid backgrounds. 4K export.

tools.name: Model Comparison
tools.description: Side-by-side model comparison. Overlay, diff, sync cameras. Compare before/after optimization.
